environmentVariables.description: Liongard Access Key ID, the half that pairs with LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET; the server composes the two into the base64 X-ROAR-API-KEY. One of two ways to authenticate - set EITHER this pair OR the pre-encoded LIONGARD_API_KEY, never both. LIONGARD_API_KEY wins when it is set, so leave it blank to use this pair.
environmentVariables.name: LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Liongard Access Key Secret, the other half of LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_ID. One of two ways to authenticate - set EITHER this pair OR the pre-encoded LIONGARD_API_KEY, never both. LIONGARD_API_KEY wins when it is set, so leave it blank to use this pair.
environmentVariables.name: LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Pre-encoded X-ROAR-API-KEY: base64 of 'accessKeyId:accessKeySecret'. One of two ways to authenticate - set EITHER this key OR the LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_ID + LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET pair, never both. This key wins when it is set, and the pair is ignored.
environmentVariables.name: LIONGARD_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from LIONGARD_INSTANCE. Set it only to point at a different host.
environmentVariables.name: LIONGARD_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Your Liongard subdomain (the 'acme' in acme.app.liongard.com); builds the API URL.
environmentVariables.name: LIONGARD_INSTANCE
